Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Are you passionate about Microsoft Azure and eager to work in a multifaceted, team-oriented environment? 
 Do you enjoy continuously expanding your cloud expertise , sharing knowledge with others, and delivering exceptional support that makes a real impact? 
 Practical Information 
 Location:  Bucharest, Romania/Sofia, Bulgaria | Work arrangement:  Hybrid | Contract type:  Full-time | Visa status: Valid working visa for Romania/Bulgaria | Language requirements: Fluent/professional English, written and verbal ; additional European languages such as German, French, or Spanish are a plus 
 Join SoftwareOne’s Azure Support Team and help deliver exceptional technical support for Azure-related incidents and service requests, ensuring customer expectations and service level agreements are consistently met. As an Azure Cloud Support - L2 , you will troubleshoot complex Azure platform issues, collaborate with global colleagues, and engage with Microsoft support when required to achieve successful outcomes. This role offers an excellent opportunity to deepen your Azure expertise , contribute to a knowledge-sharing culture, and support the development of junior team members through mentoring and guidance. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for customers on Microsoft Azure incidents and service requests 
 Diagnose and resolve complex Azure platform issues while meeting agreed service levels and customer expectations 
 Manage support tickets from investigation through resolution, ensuring a high-quality customer experience 
 Work with the latest Azure technologies to continuously expand your technical expertise 
 Collaborate with consultants and technical teams globally to gather information and solve customer challenges 
 Communicate proactively with customers during critical incidents and coordinate escalations with Microsoft Support when required 
 Share knowledge, mentor junior team members, and actively contribute to team, practice, and project communities 
 Job Requirements 
 Proven experience managing and administering Microsoft Azure services in an enterprise environment 
 Hands-on expertise supporting Azure infrastructure services, including Log Analytics, Monitoring, Cloud Backup, and Site Recovery 
 Solid practical experience with Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Virtual Machines, and Azure Networking services 
 Knowledge of Azure SQL Database and Azure migration projects is considered an advantage 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in diverse, global teams and environments 
 Familiarity with Azure Active Directory, hybrid connectivity with on-premises infrastructure, and SQL databases; AZ-900 and AZ-104 certification s are advantageous 
 What we offer:     
 Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:     
 Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture ( https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values )    
 A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action    
 President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers    
 Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities    
 Hire to Grow: We  optimize  our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future  
 Company description 
 SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.
 Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.
 Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.
